invariant.note: The 4+1 layout remains. The four content rounds must be substantive, distinct and natural.

findings.observed: The current 2009 and 2017 images show different street views. They document the redevelopment period but do not form a strong visual before/after comparison and do not show a genuinely old Torggata against the present.
required_improvements: Use a primary pair anchored to the same recognisable street segment or built element from a comparable direction and scale.
Add at least one genuinely old archival image compared with an actual current image when rights, identity and viewpoint are verified.
Keep the 2009/2017 redevelopment layer only as a clearly labelled supplemental comparison if it remains useful.
findings.acceptance: Manual UI review can identify the same place element immediately and can see both long-term historical change and any newer redevelopment change without misleading labels.

findings.observed: The News tab has no content.
required_improvements: Perform a fresh search across official actors, local media and relevant place organisations.
Publish dated, source-reviewed, place-specific items when available.
Use N/A only after documenting that fresh search and why no safe relevant item can be shown.
findings.acceptance: News contains useful current place-specific material, or a strict fresh-search N/A is documented and independently reviewable.

findings.observed: The More tab has no content despite Torggata's rich name, language, archive, observation and relation potential.
required_improvements: Search language history, archival details, observations, knowledge, fun facts and curated relations.
Produce a distinct additive layer that does not duplicate About or History.
findings.acceptance: More contains a useful Torggata-specific layer with sources and clear ownership, not filler.

findings.observed: Objects is represented by one artificial item while Structures/Buildings covers physical place elements, producing an unclear and forced split.
required_improvements: Do not retain Objects as a separate round on the strength of one arbitrary item.
Merge or replace overlapping round concepts so all four content rounds are semantically distinct.
Update the canonical round contract/runtime first if the current fixed profile prevents a coherent Torggata solution.
findings.acceptance: All four content rounds remain visible, but each has a natural label, a substantive place-specific collection and no material semantic overlap; Badge remains separate.
